archetype_none_designed_bug.explanation: Frozen classifier treats missing designed/scramble as pocket before checking carries>=5.5, so Lamar/Hurts-class rushers with null designed splits are labeled pocket_passer.

structural_causes_ranked.evidence: Depth-tier≥2 QBs assigned full active attempt rates × expected starts without sealed depth discount / residual fill (Winston, White, Rush, Kyle Allen, Beathard).
Large |expected−actual| starts among top regressors (Murray, Tannehill, Herbert, and several backups with starter-like expected starts).
Null designed/scramble → pocket before carries≥5.5 check; Lamar/Hurts-class rushers mislabeled pocket_passer under frozen H1/H2 classifier.
Candidate season attempts diverge from actual when active rates are applied without team reconcile.
Archetype mislabel + prior shrink understates designed/scramble opportunity for dual-threat starters.
Residual points error after roughly matching volume (efficiency / TD rate not jointly composed in post-hoc path).
Prior-season role/team shifts without sealed transition features in the frozen post-hoc candidate.
Frozen path has only a coarse partial_exit_rate; early-exit volume haircuts are not reconciled to backups.
Post-hoc rate×starts never saw team reconcile, depth ladder, TD constraints, or concentration — backups unbounded.
Not the 2023 failure mode: candidate applies availability once via expected starts; inflation is over-predicted starts and missing depth conservation, not rate×starts×(starts/17).
Not applicable on 2023 fold: sealed comparator is model_points_end_to_end (v1 compose), not accuracy-first blend.
